type: ℕ → ℝ

definitionValue:
fun n W =>
  ↑(ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.constantTerm n W) +
    (↑(ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 3 W) * ZetaNine.CoefficientMapSummation.zetaReal 3 +
          ↑(ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 5 W) * ZetaNine.CoefficientMapSummation.zetaReal 5 +
        ↑(ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 7 W) * ZetaNine.CoefficientMapSummation.zetaReal 7 +
      ↑(ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 9 W) * ZetaNine.CoefficientMapSummation.zetaReal 9)
type: ℕ → ℚ[X] → ℝ

definitionValue: fun n W t => ↑(ZetaNine.CoefficientMap.weightedR n W ↑(t + 1))
type: ℕ → ℚ[X] → ℕ → ℝ

∀ (n T : ℕ),
  Even n →
    ∀ (W : ℚ[X]),
      ZetaNine.CoefficientMapReflection.StrongProperMultiplier n W →
        ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.finiteL n T W =
          ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.constantTerm n W +
              (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 3 W * ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower 3 T +
                    ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 5 W * ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower 5 T +
                  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 7 W * ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower 7 T +
                ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 9 W * ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower 9 T) +
            ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.shiftedTail n T W
∀ (T : ℕ) (f : ℕ → ℝ), ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, f t = ∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, f (t + 1)
∀ (s T : ℕ), ↑(ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower s T) = ∑ t ∈ Finset.Icc 1 T, 1 / ↑t ^ s
∀ (s T : ℕ), 1 ≤ s → ↑(ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower s T) = ∑ t ∈ Finset.range (T + 1), 1 / ↑t ^ s
∀ (s : ℕ), 1 < s → ZetaNine.CoefficientMapSummation.zetaReal s = ∑' (t : ℕ), 1 / ↑t ^ s

∀ (s : ℕ),
  1 < s →
    Filter.Tendsto (fun T => ↑(ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower s T)) Filter.atTop
      (𝓝 (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapSummation.zetaReal s))
∀ (s k : ℕ), 1 ≤ s → Filter.Tendsto (fun T => 1 / (↑T + ↑k) ^ s) Filter.atTop (𝓝 0)

∀ (s j : ℕ),
  1 ≤ s →
    Filter.Tendsto
      (fun T => ↑(ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower s (T + j) - ZetaNine.HarmonicStability.harmonicPower s T))
      Filter.atTop (𝓝 0)
∀ (n : ℕ) (W : ℚ[X]), Filter.Tendsto (fun T => ↑(ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.shiftedTail n T W)) Filter.atTop (𝓝 0)

∀ (n : ℕ),
  Even n →
    ∀ (W : ℚ[X]),
      ZetaNine.CoefficientMapReflection.StrongProperMultiplier n W →
        Filter.Tendsto (fun T => ↑(ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.finiteL n T W)) Filter.atTop
          (𝓝 (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapSummation.exactL n W))
∀ (j : ℕ), Summable fun t => 1 / (↑t + 1 + ↑j) - 1 / (↑t + 1)
∀ (j s : ℕ), 2 ≤ s → Summable fun t => 1 / (↑t + 1 + ↑j) ^ s

∀ (n : ℕ) (W : ℚ[X]),
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.ProperMultiplier n W →
    ∀ (t : ℕ),
      ZetaNine.CoefficientMapSummation.actualSeries n W t =
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
          ∑ s ∈ Finset.Icc 1 9, ↑(ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.weightedLocalCoefficient n j s W) / (↑t + 1 + ↑j) ^ s

∀ (n : ℕ) (W : ℚ[X]),
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapReflection.StrongProperMultiplier n W →
    ∀ (t : ℕ),
      ZetaNine.CoefficientMapSummation.actualSeries n W t =
        ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
            ↑(ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.weightedLocalCoefficient n j 1 W) * (1 / (↑t + 1 + ↑j) - 1 / (↑t + 1)) +
          ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (n + 1),
            ∑ s ∈ Finset.Icc 2 9, ↑(ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.weightedLocalCoefficient n j s W) / (↑t + 1 + ↑j) ^ s

∀ (n : ℕ) (W : ℚ[X]),
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapReflection.StrongProperMultiplier n W →
    Summable (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapSummation.actualSeries n W)

∀ (n : ℕ) (W : ℚ[X]),
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapReflection.StrongProperMultiplier n W →
    Summable fun t => ‖ZetaNine.CoefficientMapSummation.actualSeries n W t‖

∀ (n T : ℕ) (W : ℚ[X]),
  ∑ t ∈ Finset.range T, ZetaNine.CoefficientMapSummation.actualSeries n W t =
    ↑(ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.finiteL n T W)

∀ (n : ℕ),
  Even n →
    ∀ (W : ℚ[X]),
      ZetaNine.CoefficientMapReflection.StrongProperMultiplier n W →
        HasSum (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapSummation.actualSeries n W) (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapSummation.exactL n W)

∀ (n : ℕ),
  Even n →
    ∀ (W : ℚ[X]),
      ZetaNine.CoefficientMapReflection.StrongProperMultiplier n W →
        ∑' (t : ℕ), ZetaNine.CoefficientMapSummation.actualSeries n W t = ZetaNine.CoefficientMapSummation.exactL n W

∀ (n : ℕ),
  2 ≤ n →
    Even n →
      ∀ (W : ℤ[X]),
        W.natDegree ≤ 4 →
          HasSum (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapSummation.actualSeries n (Polynomial.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ) W))
            (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapSummation.exactL n (Polynomial.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ) W))

∀ (n : ℕ),
  Even n →
    ∀ (W : ℚ[X]),
      2 * n + 2 * W.natDegree + 2 ≤ 9 * (n + 1) →
        HasSum (fun k => ↑(ZetaNine.CoefficientMap.weightedR n W ↑(k + 1)))
          (↑(ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.constantTerm n W) +
            (↑(ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 3 W) * (riemannZeta 3).re +
                  ↑(ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 5 W) * (riemannZeta 5).re +
                ↑(ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 7 W) * (riemannZeta 7).re +
              ↑(ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho n 9 W) * (riemannZeta 9).re))

∀ (n : ℕ),
  2 ≤ n →
    Even n →
      ∀ (W : ℤ[X]),
        W.natDegree ≤ 4 →
          HasSum (fun k => ↑(ZetaNine.CoefficientMap.weightedR n (Polynomial.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ) W) ↑(k + 1)))
            (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapSummation.exactL n (Polynomial.map (Int.castRingHom ℚ) W))

∀ (n : ℕ) (W : ℚ[X]),
  2 * n + 2 * W.natDegree + 2 ≤ 9 * (n + 1) → Summable fun k => ‖↑(ZetaNine.CoefficientMap.weightedR n W ↑(k + 1))‖

∀ (n T : ℕ) (W : ℚ[X]),
  ∑ k ∈ Finset.range T, ↑(ZetaNine.CoefficientMap.weightedR n W ↑(k + 1)) =
    ↑(ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.finiteL n T W)

∀ (n : ℕ) (W : ℚ[X]),
  ∑ k ∈ Finset.range 0, ZetaNine.CoefficientMapSummation.actualSeries n W k =
    ↑(ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.finiteL n 0 W)

∀ (n : ℕ) (W : ℚ[X]),
  ∑ k ∈ Finset.range 1, ZetaNine.CoefficientMapSummation.actualSeries n W k = ↑(ZetaNine.CoefficientMap.weightedR n W 1)
∀ (s : ℕ), 1 < s → (riemannZeta ↑s).re = ∑' (k : ℕ), 1 / ↑k ^ s
∀ (n : ℕ) (W : ℚ[X]), Filter.Tendsto (fun T => ↑(ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.shiftedTail n T W)) Filter.atTop (𝓝 0)
∀ (j : ℕ), Summable fun k => 1 / (↑k + 1 + ↑j) ^ 2
∀ (W : ℚ[X]), ZetaNine.CoefficientMapJet.weightedClearedSeries 0 0 W = ↑(W.comp (Polynomial.X ^ 2))
ZetaNine.CoefficientMapReflection.StrongProperMultiplier 0 (Polynomial.X ^ 3)
∀ (t : ℚ), t ≠ 0 → ZetaNine.CoefficientMap.weightedR 0 (Polynomial.X ^ 3) t = 1 / t ^ 3
∀ (k : ℕ), ZetaNine.CoefficientMapSummation.actualSeries 0 (Polynomial.X ^ 3) k = 1 / (↑k + 1) ^ 3
ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho 0 3 (Polynomial.X ^ 3) = 1
∀ (s : ℕ), 1 ≤ s → s ≤ 9 → s ≠ 3 → ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho 0 s (Polynomial.X ^ 3) = 0
ZetaNine.CoefficientMapSummation.exactL 0 (Polynomial.X ^ 3) = (riemannZeta 3).re
HasSum (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapSummation.actualSeries 0 (Polynomial.X ^ 3)) (riemannZeta 3).re

ZetaNine.CoefficientMapInjectivity.ProperMultiplier 0 (Polynomial.X ^ 4) ∧
  ¬ZetaNine.CoefficientMapReflection.StrongProperMultiplier 0 (Polynomial.X ^ 4)
∀ (k : ℕ), ZetaNine.CoefficientMapSummation.actualSeries 0 (Polynomial.X ^ 4) k = 1 / (↑k + 1)
∀ (s : ℕ), 2 ≤ s → s ≤ 9 → ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.rho 0 s (Polynomial.X ^ 4) = 0
ZetaNine.CoefficientMapSummation.exactL 0 (Polynomial.X ^ 4) = 0
¬Summable (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapSummation.actualSeries 0 (Polynomial.X ^ 4))
∀ (L : ℝ), ¬HasSum (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapSummation.actualSeries 0 (Polynomial.X ^ 4)) L

∑' (k : ℕ), ZetaNine.CoefficientMapSummation.actualSeries 0 (Polynomial.X ^ 4) k =
  ZetaNine.CoefficientMapSummation.exactL 0 (Polynomial.X ^ 4)
Filter.Tendsto (fun T => ↑(ZetaNine.CoefficientMapFiniteSum.finiteL 0 T (Polynomial.X ^ 4))) Filter.atTop Filter.atTop
∀ (n : ℕ), ZetaNine.CoefficientMapReflection.StrongProperMultiplier n 0
∀ (n : ℕ), ZetaNine.CoefficientMapSummation.actualSeries n 0 = fun x => 0
∀ (n : ℕ), HasSum (ZetaNine.CoefficientMapSummation.actualSeries n 0) 0
∀ (n : ℕ), Even n → ZetaNine.CoefficientMapSummation.exactL n 0 = 0
∀ (W : ℚ[X]), W.natDegree ≤ 4 → Summable fun k => ‖ZetaNine.CoefficientMapSummation.actualSeries 1 W k‖
